purpose: Eight not-yet-run scenarios fixed before first model use; final reader hashes refreshed after clarification and explanation-boundary fixes, independent fixture review only

checks.sufficient: 같은 지표의 전후 값과 집계 대상, 비교 기간이 제시됨
